scores.label: A
scores.note: All use 'isolation' correctly with paragraph ideas. 1 'causes his anger, not his nature' is unparallel and reads ambiguously. 3 'Repeated isolation' is an odd collocation that conflates isolation with rejection. 5 'loving people' is ambiguous. Sentences are short and plain; 1, 2 and 5 make nearly the same point.
